[!exec:node] skip 'node not in PATH'
[!wasmfx] skip 'node lacks --experimental-wasm-wasmfx stack switching'

logos build -wasm-features=stack-switching -o $WORK/exe.wasm .
exec node --experimental-wasm-wasmfx run.mjs $WORK/exe.wasm
stdout '(?m)^12$'
stdout '(?m)^2 1$'
stdout '(?m)^0$'

exists $WORK/nopath.wasm

-- go.mod --
module example.com/switch

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
)

//go:noinline
func pureLeaf(a, b int) int { return a*b + 3 }

//go:noinline
func pureSum(x int) int { return pureLeaf(x, 1) + pureLeaf(x, 2) }

//go:noinline
func pureCond(x int) int {
	if x > 10 {
		return 1
	}
	return 2
}

//go:noinline
func waits() int {
	c := make(chan int, 1)
	c <- pureSum(2)
	return <-c
}

func grow(n int) int {
	var buf [256]byte
	buf[n%256] = byte(n)
	if n == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return grow(n-1) + int(buf[n%256]&0)
}

func recovers() (r string) {
	defer func() { r = "recovered: " + fmt.Sprint(recover()) }()
	panic("boom")
}

var switches int

func main() {
	fmt.Println(waits())
	fmt.Println(pureCond(3), pureCond(30))
	fmt.Println(grow(2000))
	c := make(chan int, 1)
	go func() { c <- 7 }()
	switches++
	runtime.Gosched()
	fmt.Println(<-c)
	fmt.Println(recovers())
	fmt.Println(switches)
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- run.mjs --
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { WASI } from 'node:wasi';

const wasi = new WASI({ version: 'preview1', args: [], env: {}, returnOnExit: true });
const mod = await WebAssembly.compile(readFileSync(process.argv[2]));
const inst = await WebAssembly.instantiate(mod, wasi.getImportObject());
process.exitCode = wasi.start(inst);
